channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Knight-Wallace Journalism Fellowships 2027-28 (University of Michigan) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Wallace House Center for Journalists, University of Michigan
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 85,000 stipend plus USD 5,000 relocation (figures from secondary listings; confirm on the official site).

An academic-year fellowship for mid-career journalists to pursue a study project at the University of Michigan, with seminars and programming at Wallace House. DEADLINES: international applicants 1 December 2026, 11:59 pm ET; US applicants 1 February 2027. No application fee stated.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Sanford Underground Research Facility: Artist-in-Residence Program 2027 (Lead, South Dakota)
item.description: Sanford Underground Research Facility (SURF) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 5,000 stipend paid in two installments, plus up to USD 5,000 in additional funds the artist may apply for to create the artwork. Transportation (airfare, rental car or mileage), housing and per diem are covered for both visits; a studio space and guided surface and underground tours are provided; return shipping of the exhibition is covered up to USD 7,000.

item.title: MoHA: CATS+ Residency 2026 (Austin)
item.description: The Museum of Human Achievement (MoHA) · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · USD 1,500 honorarium, plus access to MoHA equipment and workspaces.

item.title: 1 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residency - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• American Academy in Berlin: Berlin Prize Fellowship 2027-28
    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/
    American Academy in Berlin · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 5,000, plus roundtrip airfare, accommodation at or near the Hans Arnhold Center, partial board, in-house library services and professional networking opportunities. Roughly two dozen fellowships awarded each year. No application fee.
